failed_or_abandoned: Working hypothesis that the form factor costs only x5-10 between 10 and 248 keV (N_lo ~ 3-7, borderline): abandoned after evaluating Helm/shell F2 (ratio 1.2e3-6.8e3); N_lo floor is 350 (Helm) / 1184 (shell).
Recalled CRDM flux scaling 1e-7 (sigma/1e-30)(GeV/m) replaced by the numerical PDG-spectrum integral, which differs from it by x0.06-17 depending on mass.
Separate normalisation of blazar- and decay-boosted fluxes not pursued: their N_lo obeys the same response-set floor.
